title: adas1236/KaltonPeckPalomar
summary: We prove the following mod-2 identity for real symplectic Banach spaces: If $(X, \omega)$ is a real symplectic Banach space, and $T \in L(X)$ satisfies: (1) $I + T^+T$ is Fredholm (2) $I + T^2$ has finite rank Then $\rank(T^2 + I) \equiv \dim \ker (I + T^+T) \pmod 2$. In the above, $T^+$ represents the symplectic adjoint. See our paper for more depth in definitions. This identity is applied to show that no hyperplane of the real Kalton-Peck space has a complex structure.
